title: Vault 112 Causal-Coherence Fracture and Identity-State Leak Forensics
scope: Model the system-level effect of T. Dithers' anomaly and Pinkerton's Vault 112 memory-chip exfiltration without overclaiming that the entire simulation crashed or that the stolen chip belonged to Dithers.

terminology.causal_coherence_fracture: A local failure of narrative/state consistency in which assigned memories, identity, social role and perceived environment no longer form one self-consistent history for a subject.
terminology.local_desynchronization: A participant diverges from the administered shared simulation state while the surrounding simulation continues operating for other participants.
terminology.identity_state_leak: Memory/identity state leaves the original authority boundary and becomes causally effective in another entity or system.
terminology.causal_exfiltration: A state artifact removed from one closed system produces downstream consequences outside that system.
terminology.warning: These are analytical system-design terms, not terminology used by Bethesda in shipped Fallout 3.

dithers_local_fault.subject: T. Dithers / Old Lady Dithers
confirmed_observations: Dithers states that Tranquility Lane is not real and that the residents are sleeping/dreaming.
Dithers identifies Betty as Braun behind another face.
Dithers knows that Timmy is not really a boy.
Dithers knows of the hidden failsafe and directs the Lone Wanderer toward it.
Dithers reports that she cannot sleep normally, hears voices and feels that her own skin is wrong.
Her physical Vault 112 lounger reports inconsistent readings, pod-connection warning, blood-pressure error, impossible temperature readout, extreme stress and an anomaly warning.
coherence_break_example: ADMINISTERED STATE: Betty is a little girl.
DITHERS OBSERVATION: Betty is Braun behind a false face.
ADMINISTERED STATE: Timmy is a child in this family.
DITHERS OBSERVATION: Timmy is not really a boy.
ADMINISTERED STATE: Tranquility Lane is ordinary reality.
DITHERS OBSERVATION: the world is a simulation/dream and there is an outside.
ADMINISTERED STATE: current body/skin is self-consistent.
DITHERS EXPERIENCE: her own skin does not feel right.
dithers_local_fault.interpretation: For Dithers, the system no longer supplies one coherent causal biography. Present observations conflict with the memory/identity story assigned by the administrator.

stolen_chip_causal_propagation.confirmed_source_statement: Pinkerton states that he stole a mem chip from Braun while Braun was absorbed in the simulation and that he would not know whose memories were on it until integration into a new host.
downstream_chain: -> INTEGRATION INTO A3-21 VIA CIRCUIT NEURALIZER / MEMORY PROCEDURE
-> HARKNESS BECOMES SECURITY CHIEF / COUNCIL FIGURE
-> THE REPLICATED MAN QUEST CAN RESTORE THE HIDDEN A3-21 IDENTITY
stolen_chip_causal_propagation.system_level_result: An opaque state artifact from Vault 112 becomes causally active outside Vault 112 and changes another entity's perceived identity and subsequent social trajectory.

dithers_fault_chain: Braun's closed control loop can be broken
within_vault112.cause_status: THE MIDDLE CAUSAL LINK IS PLAUSIBLE BUT NOT PROVEN; SHIPPED CONTENT CONFIRMS THE ENDPOINTS, NOT THE MECHANISM.

outside_vault112.confirmed: Pinkerton's theft creates a real downstream causal branch outside the original simulation system.
outside_vault112.meaning: The Vault 112 experiment is not causally sealed once memory-state artifacts can be removed and reused elsewhere.

pinkerton_dithers_hypothesis.hypothesis: Pinkerton stole Dithers' specific memory chip, causing her local simulation desynchronization and awareness.
supporting_circumstances: Dithers is the unique awareness witness among the original residents.
Pinkerton physically stole a Vault 112 mem chip.
Vault 112 memory technology is demonstrably capable of rewriting perceived identity.
blocking_evidence_gap: Pinkerton explicitly states that he does not know whose memories are on the chip before integration.
No shipped Form ID, terminal entry, dialogue or script binding currently identifies the stolen chip as Dithers' chip.
No shipped line states that removal of the chip caused Dithers' awareness.
pinkerton_dithers_hypothesis.promotion_rule: Do not promote to confirmed unless a shipped asset or developer source binds the stolen chip to Dithers or directly links the theft to her anomaly.

causal_integrity_contrast.vault112: A privileged administrator may overwrite participant state inside the simulation.
causal_integrity_contrast.janus_genesis: External model suggestions are non-authoritative; authoritative state changes remain bounded by runtime rules.

causal_integrity_contrast.vault112: Dithers' disagreement appears only after a fault/anomaly defeats part of the administered reality model.
causal_integrity_contrast.janus_genesis: Free Others are intentionally allowed to disagree/refuse without requiring a system fault.

causal_integrity_contrast.vault112: Opaque memory state can be stolen and made authoritative in another host.
causal_integrity_contrast.janus_genesis: Portable state is explicit JSON and memory/privacy rules reject invented hidden access; imported resident memory should remain provenance-bound.

causal_integrity_contrast.vault112: Administrator-controlled memory resets can replace the history a participant believes caused the present.
causal_integrity_contrast.janus_genesis: Chronicle/state structures preserve prior events and consequences rather than allowing an external model to silently rewrite authoritative history.

janus_genesis_comparison.engineering_lesson: A simulation remains causally auditable only if identity/memory imports carry provenance and cannot silently overwrite authoritative history.

hardening_candidate.name: CAUSAL_LINEAGE_AND_IMPORTED_MEMORY_ADMISSION_GATE
requirements: every imported resident-memory fragment declares source artifact/state ID
source and destination identity bindings are explicit
current consent/reuse policy is recorded where the design requires it
import cannot retroactively rewrite signed/authoritative Chronicle history
conflicts create a visible branch or unresolved state instead of silent overwrite
external AI-proposed memory remains non-authoritative until runtime admission
hardening_candidate.goal: Prevent a Genesis analogue of a stolen Vault 112 mem chip from silently becoming the causal truth of a resident's identity.

ru: У Dithers не доказан глобальный крах Tranquility Lane; подтверждён локальный разрыв согласованности между назначенной системой биографией и наблюдаемой ею реальностью.
Это не нарушение физической причинности, а разрыв причинно-следственной истории идентичности: прошлое, роль, тело и настоящий мир перестают складываться в одну историю.
Кража memory chip делает Vault 112 причинно незамкнутым: состояние памяти покидает систему и становится причиной новой личности Harkness за её пределами.
Связь украденного чипа именно с Dithers остаётся нерешённой и не должна становиться фактом без asset-level binding.
Для Janus Genesis главный урок Vault 112 — импорт памяти обязан иметь provenance и не должен молча переписывать авторитетную причинную историю Другого.
en: Dithers does not prove a global Tranquility Lane crash; she demonstrates a local fracture between an administered biography and observed reality.
This is not a violation of physical causality but a fracture of identity-causal coherence: past, role, body and present world no longer form one consistent history.
The stolen mem chip makes Vault 112 causally non-closed: memory state leaves the system and becomes a cause of the Harkness identity outside it.
The stolen chip is not bound to Dithers by shipped evidence and must remain unresolved until asset-level evidence is found.
For Janus Genesis, the Vault 112 lesson is that imported memory requires provenance and must not silently rewrite another resident's authoritative causal history.
